"Notwithstanding this fact, how-
ever," he asserted, "that officer,
Sergeant Kinloch, of the Shanghai
Municipal Police, suddenly started
firing a machine-gun at the City
Government police, without any
provocation on the part of the
latter.
"This was, apparently, a chal-

ernment and caused several casual-

《上海泰晤士报》

1939年8月22日

日本指责工部局警务处开枪

使馆发言人将全部责任归咎于上海公共租界工部局；称金洛克在无挑衅情况下首先开火

日本大使馆发言人在昨天的记者招待会上告诉记者，日本当局认为，周六晚间在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）发生的道台警察与上海公共租界工部局警务处之间的枪击事件，其全部责备和责任都应由工部局承担。他指出，上海公共租界工部局警务处的英国巡长突然用机枪向上海市政府警察开火，而后者没有丝毫挑衅。发言人补充说，因此日本当局对整个事件持非常严肃的看法。

使馆发言人说：“关于上海公共租界工部局警务处一名警官杀害上海市政府警察的极司菲尔路事件，当地报纸已有大量报道，给人的印象是责任完全在于被杀的中国警官。日本当局在经过非常彻底的调查后认为，责任和过错主要在于工部局警务处。”

随后他阐述了对该问题的看法。“8月19日下午，极司菲尔路发生了一起不幸事件，”使馆发言人说，“当时一名武装的工部局警务处成员向几名市政府警察开火，造成数人伤亡。此前，市政府警察一直被允许穿越越界筑路区域，以执行维持治安的任务。

“尽管有这一事实，工部局警务处的见习巡长金洛克（Kinloch）在市政府警察未作任何挑衅的情况下，突然开始用机枪向他们开火。”

对市政府的挑战

“这显然是对上海市政府的挑战，因此过错和责任完全在于工部局警务处。我们无法理解，本应负责维持治安的上海公共租界工部局警务处成员，竟然自己采取扰乱此地治安的行动。

“在近期于东京达成的有田-克莱琪（Arita-Craigle）协定中，英国政府承认了中国存在大规模敌对行动的实际情况，并同意限制任何不利于日本而有利于其敌人的行动。最近发生的不幸事件显然违反了这一协定，”发言人说。

Anti-British Movements
"We have often heard criticisms of the actions of the Japanese in connection with Tientsin, where British nationals were allegedly subjected to improper treatment. Such complaints, however, cannot be compared with the recent incident which caused deaths and injuries among the members of the police of the City Government. Furthermore, Great Britain denounces the anti-British movements being conducted in various parts of China now, but it seems to me," said the spokesman, "that such anti-British movements should not occasion surprise if Chinese lives are so lightly treated by the British. Indeed, should there be any intensification of the anti-British movement in the future, the responsibility should lie with the British."
"Needless to say, the incident is a matter which concerns the S.M.C. and the City Government, and, at the same time, it is a matter of grave concern to the Japanese authorities who are in special and very close relationship to the City Government, and to the Japanese military authorities, upon whom lies the responsibility of maintaining peace and order in the Shanghai area.
"Measures to be taken with regard to the incident have been referred for careful consideration to the representatives of the Japanese Foreign Office, Navy and Army. This incident is not likely to be lightly overlooked by the Japanese, who feel very strongly on this point," concluded the Embassy spokesman.

Japanese Press Comment
Recognition of the administrative and other rights of the Shanghai Special Municipality on extra-Settlement Roads was demanded by Mayor Fu Ssu-en in a protest filed yesterday afternoon with Mr. C. S. Franklin, Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council, in connection with the shooting incident on Jessfield Road Saturday night, the "Tairiku Shimpo" said yesterday evening.
Two policemen of the Special Municipality were killed and several others wounded in a clash with Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kelloch, of the S. M. P. Mayor Fu demanded also that the Shanghai Municipal Council tender an apology for the incident, punish the S.M.P. constables involved, and compensate the victims.
In notes to Mr. Franklin, Mr. Poul Scheel, senior member of the Consular Body, and M. M. Baudez, French Consul-General, the transfer to the Special Municipality of jurisdiction over special district courts in the Settlement and Concession was demanded by Mayor Fu.

反英运动

“我们经常听到针对日本人在天津事件中行为的批评，据称英国国民在那里受到了不当对待。然而，此类投诉无法与最近导致市政府警察成员伤亡的事件相提并论。此外，大不列颠谴责目前在中国各地进行的反英运动，但在我看来，”发言人说，“如果英国人如此轻视中国人的生命，这种反英运动的发生就不应令人惊讶。的确，如果将来反英运动有任何加剧，责任应由英国承担。”

“不用说，该事件是关系到上海公共租界工部局和市政府的事项，同时，对于与市政府有着特殊且非常密切关系的日本当局，以及负有维持上海地区和平与秩序责任的日本军事当局来说，这也是一个严重关切的问题。

“关于对该事件采取的措施，已提交给日本外务省、海军和陆军的代表进行仔细审议。日本人对此点感受强烈，该事件不太可能被轻易忽视，”使馆发言人总结道。

日本报刊评论

据《大陆新报》昨晚报道，福斯恩（Fu Ssu-en，音译）市长昨天下午就周六晚极司菲尔路枪击事件向上海公共租界工部局主席富兰克林（C. S. Franklin）先生提交抗议书，要求承认上海特别市在越界筑路区域的行政权及其他权利。

特别市的两名警察在与工部局警务处见习巡长 W. L. Kelloch（音译）的冲突中丧生，另有数人受伤。福市长还要求上海公共租界工部局就此事件道歉，惩处涉案的工部局警务处警员，并向受害者提供赔偿。

福市长在向富兰克林先生、领事团资深成员舍尔（Poul Scheel）先生以及法国总领事博德兹（M. M. Baudez）先生提交的照会中，要求将租界和法租界内特区法院的管辖权移交给特别市。

《字林西报》
1939年8月22日
23926

称东京协定
遭违反

武装冲突归咎于
上海公共租界工部局警务处；事件正受
“慎重考虑”

日本大使馆发言人在昨日的记者招待会上发表声明称，鉴于上周六晚在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）事件中涉及两名“大道”警察被杀一案的上海公共租界工部局警务处英籍见习巡佐 W. L. Kinloch 的行为违反了最近在东京达成的克莱琪-有田（Craigie-Arita）“协定”，当地日本当局对该事件持严肃态度，“已提交陆、海、外务三省代表进行慎重考虑”。该发言人指出，当地报纸大量报道给人的印象是，租界当局采取了一种立场，即责任完全在于那名被杀的中国警官。然而，日本当局在全面调查的基础上，采取了相反的看法。

声明内容

随后，大使馆发言人发表了如下声明：——8月19日下午，极司菲尔路发生了一起不幸事件，当时武装的工部局警察向上海市政府警察开枪，造成数人伤亡。此前，上海市政府警察在实际操作中一直被允许穿越越界筑路区域，以履行其维持治安的职责。尽管有此事实，但工部局警务处的见习巡佐 W. L. Kinloch 突然在后者没有任何挑衅行为的情况下，用机枪向上海市政府警察开火，造成数人伤亡。
这显然是对市政府的挑战，因此过错和责任完全在于工部局警务处。我们无法理解，本应负责维持治安的工部局警务处成员，竟然亲自采取可能扰乱治安的行动。

违反协定

在最近于东京缔结的有田-克莱琪协定中，英国政府承认了中国正在进行大规模敌对行动的实际情况，并同意控制任何不利于日本而有利于其敌人的行动。最近发生的不幸事件显然违反了该协定。我们经常听到来自各方的批评，指责日本在天津事件中涉嫌对英国国民施加不当待遇。然而，每个人都会同意，此类抱怨无法与最近导致上海市政府警察成员死伤的事件相提并论。
英国也谴责在中国各地进行的反英运动，但在我们看来，如果英国人如此轻视中国人的生命，那么出现这种反英运动也就不足为奇了。即使将来反英运动加剧，责任也应归于英国方面。

pages.en:
23927

Grave Concern
Needless to say, the incident is a matter that concerns the Municipal Council and the City Government, but, at the same time, it is also a matter of grave concern to the Japanese authorities, who are in a special and close relationship with the Reformed Government, and to the Japanese military authorities who have charge of the maintenance of peace and order in the Shanghai district. Measures to be taken with regard to the incident have been referred for careful consideration to the local representatives of the Japanese Army, Navy and Foreign Office. This incident is not likely to be lightly overlooked by the Japanese, who feel very strongly on this point.
Asked who was responsible for the maintenance of peace and order in the territory which was controlled by the City Government as the Craigie-Arita agreement had been mentioned as giving the control to the Japanese Army, the spokesman replied that it was the joint duty of the City Government and the Japanese Forces.
"Had a non-British subject been concerned in this incident," another pressman asked, "would the spokesman have taken the view that it came within the scope of the Craigie-Arita agreement?" The reply was that the question was a hypothetical one. The agreement had been mentioned since the police officer concerned had been British.
"If an American had been involved instead would the U.S.A. have been implicated?" the same questioner asked. To this the spokesman replied that it would be difficult to say because there happened to be no such agreement with the United States.
"You cannot ignore the fact that the man was British," the spokesman added. The lodging of a protest with the British authorities was under consideration, he concluded,, as the spirit of the Craigie-Arita agreement had been violated.
pages.zh:
23927

严重关切

毋庸赘言，该事件是关乎工部局和市政府的事情，但同时，对于与维新政府有着特殊密切关系的日本当局，以及负责上海地区治安维持的日本军事当局来说，这也是一个严重关切的问题。关于该事件拟采取的措施，已提交给日本陆军、海军和外务省的当地代表进行慎重考虑。日本人对此点感受强烈，不太可能轻易放过这一事件。
当被问及既然提到克莱琪-有田协定将控制权交给日本军队，那么在市政府控制的领土内，谁负责维持治安时，发言人回答说，这是市政府和日本军队的共同职责。
另一位记者问道：“如果涉案者是非英国籍人士，发言人是否会认为这属于克莱琪-有田协定的范围？”回答是，这是一个假设性问题。之所以提及该协定，是因为涉案警官是英国人。
同一位提问者又问：“如果是美国人卷入其中，美国是否会被牵涉进来？”发言人回答说，这很难说，因为恰好与美国没有此类协定。
发言人补充道：“你不能忽视此人是英国人这一事实。”他最后表示，由于违反了克莱琪-有田协定的精神，正在考虑向英国当局提出抗议。

CHINA PRESS.
AUG 22 1939

S.M.C. Will
Also Protest
On Shooting

Council Demarche To
Be Included In
Reply To Fu

The Shanghai Municipal Council yesterday decided to deliver a written protest against the shooting affray on Jessfield Road during which Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kinloch was injured during a gun battle with armed "Ta Tao" agents.

The Council's demarche will be in the nature of a counter-protest against the communication sent to the S.M.C. by Fu Siao-ei, "mayor" of the local Nipponese-sponsored regime.

It was reported last night that the Council's answer will be sent directly to Fu, with whom the S.M.C. has hitherto had no official dealings. Information reaching THE CHINA PRESS last night stated that such a reply to the puppet "mayor" would not constitute an official recognition of the local regime.

"Mayor" Fu's note was received late yesterday afternoon following an earlier personal call by the official on Mr. Cornell S. Franklin, Chairman of the Council.

Meanwhile, it was observed that Japanese troops beyond the British defense sector at Jessfield Park, had been given large reinforcements and patrolled up and down their side of the railway tracks in trucks.

Investigation Continues

Investigation of the fight continued yesterday, both the S.M.P. and the "Ta Tao," claiming that the other side was responsible for firing first. Ballistic experts of the S. M. P. will know today whether the bullets fired by "Ta Tao" men came from guns previously known to the crime department. Sergeant Kinloch was reported yesterday to be making good progress in the Country Hospital where he has received numerous messages of felicitation on his courageous handling of the incident.

Two survivors of the four "Ta Tao" men hit by Sergeant Kinloch were removed yesterday from the Police hospital on Shanhaikwan Road to the Foo Min hospital in Hongkew. Two others were mortally wounded Saturday by Sergeant Kinloch when he opened up on them with a Thompson sub-machine gun.

《大美晚报》
1939年8月22日

工部局也将
就枪击事件
提出抗议

理事会的交涉将
包含在对傅
筱庵的回复中

上海公共租界工部局昨日决定就极司菲尔路的枪击混战事件递交书面抗议，在此次与武装“大道”特工的枪战中，见习巡佐 W. L. Kinloch 受伤。

工部局的此次外交交涉，性质上是对当地日本扶植政权“市长”傅筱庵发给工部局的照会的一种 counter-protest（反向抗议）。

昨晚据报道，工部局的答复将直接发送给傅筱庵，此前工部局与其并无官方往来。昨晚传给《大美晚报》的消息称，对此傀儡“市长”的此类回复并不构成对当地政权的官方承认。

傅“市长”的照会是昨天下午晚些时候收到的，此前该官员曾亲自拜访过工部局主席康奈尔·S·富兰克林（Cornell S. Franklin）先生。

与此同时，人们注意到，在极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）英军防御区之外的日军已得到大量增援，并乘坐卡车在铁轨的日方一侧来回巡逻。

调查仍在继续

昨日的战斗调查仍在继续，工部局警务处和“大道”方面均声称是对方首先开火。工部局警务处的弹道专家今日将能确定“大道”人员射出的子弹是否来自刑事科此前已知的枪支。据报道，Kinloch 巡佐在乡村医院（Country Hospital）恢复良好，他因勇敢处理该事件而收到了许多祝贺信。

被 Kinloch 巡佐击中的四名“大道”人员中的两名幸存者，昨日从山海关路警察医院被转移至虹口的福民医院。另外两人在周六被 Kinloch 巡佐使用汤姆逊冲锋枪扫射时受致命伤。

KILCHINA DAILY NEWS.

Aug 22 1939

Shooting Stirs Nanking
Officialdom

Anti-British Feeling
Increased

Nanking, Aug. 21.
Anti-British feeling here was intensified today by reports of the shooting affray between Ta Tao police and the S.M.P. in the western district of Shanghai, with civic organizations opposed to British policy demanding that the Shanghai Special Municipality take drastic measures against the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Leaders of anti-British groups here claimed that the incident was an "insult" to the "Reformed Government" and an act of provocation by the Shanghai Municipal Council. Some agitators were demanding that Britons be "driven out of China."
The Ta Min' Hui called an emergency mass meeting yesterday at which it was decided to launch a campaign to restore the Shanghai Settlement to Chinese control by 'mobilizing the people.'
The following statement was issued by Mr. Mi, Tai-chang, Chairman of the Ta Min Hui:
"In the first place such incidents happen only because of the existence of foreign concessions and settlements. As a step to prevent any more incidents of this kind we demand the immediate return of foreign concessions. If our demands are not met we will mobilize the Chinese people to urge the Reformed Government to recover the concessions."

《华北每日新闻》

1939年8月22日

枪击事件震动
南京官场

反英情绪
高涨

南京，8月21日电。
今天，有关上海西区“大道”警察与工部局警务处之间发生枪击混战的报道，使这里的反英情绪进一步高涨，反对英国政策的市民团体要求上海特别市对上海公共租界工部局采取严厉措施。
这里的反英团体领导人声称，该事件是对“维新政府”的“侮辱”，也是上海公共租界工部局的挑衅行为。一些煽动者要求将英国人“赶出中国”。
“大民会”昨天召开紧急群众大会，决定通过“动员民众”发起一场运动，以恢复上海租界由中国控制。
“大民会”主席米泰昌先生发表了以下声明：
“首先，此类事件的发生仅仅是因为外国租界和居留地的存在。作为防止此类事件再次发生的步骤，我们要求立即归还外国租界。如果我们的要求得不到满足，我们将动员中国人民敦促维新政府收回租界。”

CHINA PRESS.

AUG 22 1939

Muzzle The “Ta Tao”

TWO grave events marred local news during the past week. On Friday, Mr. Holger Peter Krogh, a Dane, was murdered in cold blood by two assassins, whose only apparent motive was revenge. Thirty-three hours later, Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kinloch was shot in the back as he challenged a group of armed plain-clothesmen on a municipal road.

In the first case, there has been sufficient evidence to indicate that the killing was committed by men closely linked with the so-called “Ta Tao” police, who bore a grudge against Mr. Krogh. In the second incident, the men involved in the clash were members of the “Ta Tao” force, trespassing on Settlement territory.

The two events served to bring into relief the abnormality of the existing situation and the urgent need of immediate drastic steps by those in actual control in the territory surrounding the Settlement.

It is idle at this moment to tell the Japanese that the situation presents a golden opportunity to demonstrate the sincerity of their professed desire to co-operate with the Settlement authorities in maintaining peace and order in the area. They have had this opportunity for more than two years now, but have failed to take advantage of it.

Shanghai’s badlands today are the world’s worst criminal-infested area. Gambling establishments, opium dens and similar institutions openly pursue their trade. Large bands of armed men make frequent forays into the foreign-controlled areas. The badlands form the base of operations for the thieves and hold-up men who collect such a terrifying toll of life and money from the city’s population.

It is an open secret that gambling, opium-trading and kindred occupations are being carried on with the sanction of the Japanese Special Service Section and the “Ta Tao” police. The badlands cannot be cleaned up as long as the Japanese find it advantageous to maintain the present chaotic conditions along the fringes of the Settlement.

The only way to deal with the problem, therefore, is for the S.M.C. to make full use of its virtually unlimited police powers and display that firmness which alone seems to make impression on the elements inimical to the Settlement.

Since July 22, when a band of gunmen ventured forth from their lair in “Ta Tao” territory off Edinburgh Road, to raid two Chinese newspapers and kill an American, the two foreign

《大美晚报》

1939年8月22日

制服“大道”

过去一周内，两起严重事件破坏了本地新闻。周五，丹麦人霍尔格·彼得·克罗格（Holger Peter Krogh）先生被两名刺客冷血谋杀，其明显的动机仅为复仇。三十三小时后，见习巡佐 W. L. Kinloch 在一条工部局道路上挑战一群武装便衣人员时背部中枪。

在第一起案件中，已有充分证据表明，杀人者是那些与所谓“大道”警察关系密切且对克罗格先生怀恨在心的人所为。在第二起事件中，参与冲突的人员是“大道”部队成员，他们侵入了租界领土。

这两起事件突显了当前局势的异常，以及周围地区实际控制者急需立即采取严厉步骤。

此刻告诉日本人，局势提供了一个绝佳机会来证明他们声称希望与租界当局合作以维持该地区和平与秩序的诚意，是徒劳的。他们拥有这个机会已经两年多了，但未能加以利用。

如今的上海“坏地带”是世界上犯罪活动最猖獗的地区。赌场、鸦片馆及类似机构公开经营。大批武装人员频繁突袭外国人控制的区域。“坏地带”构成了窃贼和抢劫犯的行动基地，他们从城市人口中攫取了令人恐惧的生命和金钱代价。

众所周知的是，赌博、鸦片贸易及相关行业是在日本特务机关和“大道”警察的默许下进行的。只要日本人认为维持租界边缘目前的混乱状态对其有利，“坏地带”就无法得到清理。

因此，解决这一问题的唯一途径是，工部局充分利用其几乎无限的警察权力，展现出那种似乎唯一能对敌视租界的势力产生影响的坚定态度。

自7月22日以来，一伙枪手从爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）外“大道”地区的巢穴中冒险出动，袭击了两家中文报社并杀害了一名美国人，这两名外国

各市政当局在处理当前的恐怖统治时，表现出了值得称赞的坚定态度。
然而，所采取的措施尚不足以遏制租界以外地区的持枪歹徒。除了克雷格（Kregh）和金洛克（Kinloch）事件外，在过去的一个月里，至少还发生过一起警车遭到匪徒袭击的事件，导致两名华籍巡捕受伤。因此，显然需要采取更严厉的步骤。这些措施似乎应遵循以下方针：
1. 对“大道”（Ta Tao）地区中警方已知藏匿罪犯的部分实施“隔离”；
2. 对诸如赌博和鸦片馆等非法场所实施“隔离”，这些场所可通往租界。
3. 就金洛克事件以及此后涉及“大道”地区居民袭击租界巡捕和居民的所有事件，向日本当局提出迅速而有力的抗议。
4. 采取措施，使工部局的立场获得至少与日本方面同等广泛的国际宣传。租界的力量部分在于海外知情的公众舆论，必须尽一切努力让世界随时了解日本在这个国家对外国权利的最新侵犯。
傅筱庵（Fu Siao-en）昨天致上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.）的“照会”由日本陆军发言人发布，这一事实本身就表明日本希望继续利用其傀儡在此向列强索取让步。
然而，日本应该意识到，她正在着手进行一场比封锁天津英租界严重得多的冒险。众所周知，理查德（Richard）掌掴案在美国引起了普遍的强烈愤慨。如果卷入的不是一个人，而是一个庞大的美国社群，反日情绪又会高涨多少呢？
因此，要求日本管束“大道”的呼吁，不能基于其诚意或缺乏诚意，而必须基于其自身的物质利益。如果她希望缩小自己与世界——包括美国——之间现有的差距，唯一的途径就是通过克制并停止排外行动。

CHINA DAILY NEWS.
AUG 22 1934

Shooting in Jessfield Rd.
The regrettable shooting affray in Jessfield Road on Saturday night, in which a foreign member of the Shanghai Municipal Police was wounded in the back and two members of the Special Municipality police were shot dead and several others wounded, is having curious repercussions in the local Japanese press. Every effort appears to be made to magnify the affair into an international incident, and even to link it with the Tientsin silver issue and Britain's general Far Eastern policy. As the facts of the case are not sufficient to enable this to be done successfully, versions of the shooting which are travesties of what actually occurred are being issued, and interviews with the wounded men which are directly at variance with the accounts given by the S. M. Police party and other eye-witnesses at the scene at the time, are being published. The incident arose fundamentally out of the difficult conditions imposed upon those who are responsible for law and order in the International Settlement. Owing to the inability or unwillingness of those whose duty it is to preserve order in the areas round the Settlement and the Settlement roads, it has been necessary for S. M. P. patrols to be constantly on the watch. These patrols have an unenviable task, as a review of last week's affrays proves. They take their lives in their hands and may be subjected to sudden fire at any moment, from gangsters and others who have no cause to love them. Against these risks, their best safeguard is speed in replying in kind, and thus a state of affairs has been created in which the slightest incident may precipitate a serious gun-battle. Such a battle occurred on Saturday night. A police patrol in an armoured car held up, in the course of their duty, a Ta Tao patrol on a municipal road. The S.M.P. were quite within their rights. But a Ta Tao plain-clothes man shot one of the patrol in the back, and the wounded man replied. The Ta Tao patrol got considerably the worst of the encounter, and as a result protests have been lodged and the Japanese, who hitherto have taken the line that what is done by the Ta Tao administration is no concern of theirs, are threatening "drastic action." The poorness of the Ta Tao administration's case in this instance is shown by the arguments the Japanese spokesman on Sunday was forced to dig up in support of it. These included an attempt to make out that the incident on Saturday was in revenge for the killing of Mr. H. P. Krogh on Friday, on the very flimsy pretext that the armoured car involved on Saturday was somewhere in the vicinity when a flag was torn down from the Jessfield Road Ta Tao Police station some time ago. Also included is the plea that the police took away the wounded in the shooting. Humanitarian grounds alone dictated this, and there can be no question, as was asserted by the Japanese spokesman, that the wounded were taken to hospital so that their evidence should not be available to the Ta Tao police. The very fact that Japanese reporters have been able to interview the wounded is sufficient denial of any ulterior S.M.P. motives. In these times of international tension, it is essential that incidents such as Saturday's, which are deeply to be deplored but which are almost certain to occur in present conditions, should be examined coolly and dispassionately so that a reasonable solution should be found. Distortion of facts and efforts to fan the flames of hatred must be deprecated.

《字林西报》（CHINA DAILY NEWS）。
1934年8月22日

极司菲尔路枪击事件
上周六晚在极司菲尔路发生的令人痛心的枪战，导致一名上海公共租界工部局警务处（Shanghai Municipal Police）的外籍巡捕背部受伤，两名特别市警察被枪杀，另有数人受伤，此事在当地日本报刊中引发了奇特的反响。似乎各方都在极力将此事件放大为国际事件，甚至将其与天津白银问题及英国的一般远东政策联系起来。由于案件事实不足以支持这种说法，于是发布了歪曲实际发生情况的枪击版本，并刊登了对伤者的采访，这些采访与当时在场的工部局警务处人员及其他目击者提供的证词直接相悖。这一事件根本上源于对负责国际租界治安者所施加的困难处境。由于那些有责任维持租界周边地区及租界道路秩序的人无力或不愿履行职责，工部局警务处的巡逻队不得不时刻保持警惕。正如对上周冲突的回顾所证明的那样，这些巡逻队面临着令人羡慕不来的任务。他们冒着生命危险，随时可能遭到那些没有理由喜欢他们的匪徒和其他人的突然射击。针对这些风险，他们最好的保障是迅速以牙还牙，从而造成了一种 slightest incident（最微小的事件）都可能引发严重枪战的局面。周六晚上就发生了这样一场战斗。一辆装甲车内的警察巡逻队在执行公务时，在一条市政道路上拦下了一支“大道”巡逻队。工部局警务处完全有权这样做。但一名“大道”便衣人员从背后射击了一名巡逻队员，伤者进行了还击。“大道”巡逻队在这场遭遇战中吃了大亏，结果导致了抗议，而此前一直声称“大道”当局的行为与他们无关的日本人也威胁要采取“严厉行动”。日本发言人在周日被迫挖出支持这一立场的论点，显示了“大道”当局在此案中的理屈词穷。其中包括试图声称周六的事件是为了报复周五H. P. Krogh先生被杀一事，其借口极其牵强，即周六涉及的装甲车曾在不久前极司菲尔路“大道”警察局旗杆上的旗帜被扯下时出现在附近。还包括一种辩解，称警方带走了枪击案中的伤者。此举纯粹出于人道主义考虑，绝不存在如日本发言人所声称的那样，将伤者送往医院是为了不让“大道”警方获取其证词。日本记者能够采访伤者这一事实本身，就足以否认工部局警务处有任何不可告人的动机。在国际紧张局势加剧的当下，对于像周六那样令人深感遗憾但在当前条件下几乎必然发生的事件，必须冷静、客观地加以审视，以便找到合理的解决方案。必须谴责歪曲事实和煽动仇恨火焰的行为。

《字林西报》（NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS）。

1939年8月22日

南京赞成
隔离方案

南京，8月21日电。
维新政府官员和这里的反英组织今天主张采取措施，隔离上海国际租界，或将其归还中国当局管辖。
这种采取激烈行动的愿望，根源于这里对上海公共租界工部局日益增长的不满，原因是上海租界内发生了众多事件和暴力爆发。维新政府外交部政治事务局局长王赞子（Wang Tsan-tzu）今晨离开此地前往上海。
—Domel.

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,

AUG 27 1939

Another Jessfield
Incident Reported

Japanese Spokesman States
"Ta Tao" Party Held Up by
Settlement Police

Another incident in which a Settlement police patrol and a party of "Ta Tao" officers were concerned was reported at the Japanese press conference yesterday as having taken place earlier in the day. According to a military spokesman three Britons and three Chinese, all members of the S.M.P., and 17 "Ta Tao" men were involved in the incident.

While proceeding along Jessfield Road, the spokesman revealed, the Municipality police party was stopped by armoured car No. 1, which was manned by the three Britons and the three Chinese, near the spot where Saturday's incident involving Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kinloch took place.

One of the Britons then told the leader of the Municipality party, an officer named Yao, that as the road was a part of the Settlement, the group had no right to be there, the spokesman stated. "You must not use this road," the British police officer was alleged to have said.

Threatening Attitude

In reply to this, the spokesman continued, Yao stated that the road did not belong to the S.M.C. and that they were traversing the road on instructions from superior authorities and if the Settlement police had any objections they had better take the matter up with these authorities.

"Although the Settlement police in question assumed a threatening attitude," the spokesman said, "and again held a machine-gun ready, the City Government police passed through without further trouble."

Answering questions, the spokesman said that unless the blame for Saturday's incident could be put upon the shoulders of the Municipality police, members of this force would continue to carry out their usual practice. Asked what this was, the spokesman said that the Municipality Government adopted the view that its police were entitled to patrol the extension roads.

The Bubbling Well Police stated last night that they knew that such an incident was reported at the Japanese press conference, but they denied that the incident as reported had happened. .

1939年8月27日

据报道又发生一起
极司菲尔路事件

日本发言人称
“大道”一行人员
遭租界警察拦截

据昨日日本新闻发布会报道，当天早些时候发生了一起涉及租界警察巡逻队和一群“大道”警官的事件。据一位军方发言人透露，共有三名英籍人员和三名华籍人员（均为工部局警务处成员）以及17名“大道”人员卷入了该事件。

发言人透露，当工部局警察一行人在极司菲尔路行进时，在上周六涉及见习巡佐W. L. Kinloch的事件发生地点附近，被载有三名英籍人员和三名华籍人员的1号装甲车拦下。

发言人称，其中一名英籍人员随后告诉工部局一行的领队、一名姓姚的警官，由于该道路是租界的一部分，该群体无权在此停留。据称，这名英籍警官曾说：“你们不得使用这条道路。”

威胁姿态

发言人继续说，作为回应，姚表示该道路不属于上海公共租界工部局（S.M.C.），他们是奉上级命令通过该道路，如果租界警察有任何异议，最好向这些上级当局提出。

发言人说：“尽管相关的租界警察摆出了威胁姿态，”并再次准备好机枪，但市政府警察未受进一步干扰便通过了。”

在回答提问时，发言人表示，除非能将周六事件的责任归咎于工部局警察，否则该部队成员将继续执行其惯例。当被问及这是什么惯例时，发言人说，工部局政府认为其警察有权在越界筑路区域进行巡逻。

静安寺路警察分局昨晚表示，他们知道日本新闻发布会上报道了此类事件，但他们否认报道中的事件确实发生过。.

SHANGHAI TIMES.

AUG 23 1934

Another
Jessfield
“Brush”

Parties Of S.M.P. And
Ta Tao Police Meet
On Jessfield Rd.

According to the spokesman at the
Japanese Press Conference last
evening, men of the Ta Tao and
Settlement Police had an altercation
on Jessfield Road yesterday morn-
ing at 7.15.

The spokesman reported that a
party of police belonging to the
Special Municipality were proceed-
ing along Jessfield Road, near the
spot where the shooting affray took
place last Saturday night. Here
they met armoured car No. 1, be-
longing to the Shanghai Municipal
Police. The occupants of the car
were three British police and one
Chinese policeman. The party of
Special Municipality police number-
ed 17, under Police Chief Yao.

One of the British police said to
Police Chief Yao that this road was
under the S. M. C. and that the
Special Municipality police could
not use it, Police Chief Yao replied,
according to the spokesman, that he
did not think that the road belonged
to the Shanghai Municipal Council
and that he was traversing it on in
compliance with instructions from
superior authority. If the S.M.P.
had any objections they should con-
sult his superior authority.

Although the S.M.P. in question
assumed a threatening attitude with
machine-guns, said the spokesman,
the Chinese Police passed through
without further trouble.

Questions Asked

“Are the Ta Tao police now, in
fact, attempting to control the
road?” asked a correspondent.

“Inasmuch as the Chinese police
were patrolling the roads prior to
the incident there is no question
that they will continue to perform
this duty,” answered the spokesman.

“Were the Ta Tao police merely
crossing or patrolling the road when
the alleged meeting took place yes-
terday morning?” asked a newsman.

“I do not know whether they
were passing through or patrolling
the road at the time,” answered the
spokesman, “but I am of the opinion
they were patrolling the road.”

“Then the present situation is
that two armed parties are patrol-
ling the same road, is that it?”
asked a correspondent. “Yes, I think
that’s about the situation,” replied
the spokesman, smilingly.

1934年8月23日

另一起极司菲尔路
“摩擦”事件

工部局警务处与
大道警察在极司菲尔路相遇

据昨晚日本新闻发布会上的发言人称，大道和租界警察的人员于昨天早上7点15分在极司菲尔路发生争执。

发言人报告称，一支属于特别市的警察队伍正沿着极司菲尔路行进，靠近上周六晚发生枪战的地点。在这里，他们遇到了属于上海公共租界工部局警务处的1号装甲车。车内乘员为三名英籍巡捕和一名华籍巡捕。特别市警察队伍共有17人，由姚警长率领。

据发言人称，其中一名英籍巡捕对姚警长说，这条道路归上海公共租界工部局（S. M. C.）管辖，特别市警察不得使用。姚警长回答说，他认为该道路不属于上海公共租界工部局，他是奉上级命令通过该道路。如果工部局警务处有任何异议，他们应咨询他的上级当局。

发言人说，尽管相关的工部局警务处人员摆出威胁姿态并架设机枪，但中国警察未受进一步干扰便通过了。

提出问题

“那么，大道警察现在实际上是在试图控制这条道路吗？”一名记者问道。

“鉴于中国警察在事件发生前一直在巡逻道路，毫无疑问他们将继续履行这一职责，”发言人回答道。

“据称昨天早上相遇发生时，大道警察只是在穿越道路还是在巡逻道路？”一名新闻工作者问道。

“我不知道他们当时是在通过还是巡逻道路，”发言人回答道，“但我认为他们是在巡逻道路。”

“那么目前的情况是两武装方都在巡逻同一条道路，是这样吗？”一名记者问道。“是的，我想情况大致如此，”发言人微笑着回答道。

AUG 23 1929
23968

Council Also Lodges
Strong Protest Over
Jessfield Rd. Affair

Settlement Governing
Body Takes Stand
Backing Kinloch

JAPANESE ISSUE
FIRM STATEMENT

Army And Navy Regard
Saturday Incident In
Grave Light

The Shanghai Municipal
Council yesterday afternoon
flatly rejected the four de-
mands made upon that body
Monday by Fu Siao-en,
"mayor" of the "Shanghai
Special Municipal Govern-
ment," in connection with the
Jessfield Road shooting Satur-
day afternoon in which Pro-
bationary Sergeant W. L.
Kinloch, of the S.M.P., was
wounded and two "Ta Tao"
policemen killed and two
others hurt.

Taking further action in re-
gard to the matter, the S.M.C.
also lodged a strong protest with
Fu Siao-en against the appear-
ance of "Ta Tao" police on
extra-Settlement Roads and the
action of "Ta Tao" police in
firing upon a member of the
Shanghai Municipal Police.

The protest and the rejection of
the demands were conveyed to Fu
Siao-en in a lengthy note issued
by the Council last night. The
Japanese Consul-General also was
notified of the contents of the note
and of the willingness of the S.M.C.
to have the whole of the evidence
examined by a disinterested inquiry.

Japanese Statement

Receipt of the Council's note by
Fu Siao-en was followed by a strong
statement issued by the Japanese
military and naval authorities in
Shanghai. This document expressed
determination of these authorities
to take "effective and appropriate
measures to eradicate at the roots
the 'evils' responsible for the Jess-
field Road shooting incident.

In addition to the Japanese joint
army and navy statement, a Tokyo
report carried by Reuters last night
declared that the "Reformed Gov-
ernment Foreign Office" has worked
out a plan for the rendition of the
International Settlement at Shang-
hai, as the fundamental solution of
the question of international settle-
ments and foreign concessions in
China.

1929年8月23日

工部局也就极司菲尔路事件
提出强烈抗议

租界管理机构
表态支持金洛克

日本方面
发表强硬声明

陆海军当局
视周六事件为严重事态

上海公共租界工部局昨日下午断然拒绝了“上海特别市政府”“市长”傅筱庵于本周一就周六下午发生的极司菲尔路枪击事件向该机构提出的四项要求。在该事件中，上海公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）见习巡长 W. L. 金洛克（W. L. Kinloch）受伤，两名“大道”警察身亡，另两人受伤。

工部局就此事项采取进一步行动，还就“大道”警察出现在越界筑路区域以及“大道”警察向上海公共租界警务处成员开枪的行为，向傅筱庵提出强烈抗议。

上述抗议及对要求的拒绝，已载于工部局昨晚发出的一份长篇照会中并传达给傅筱庵。日本总领事亦获知该照会内容，以及工部局愿意由公正的调查方审查全部证据的意愿。

日本方面的声明

傅筱庵收到工部局照会后，驻沪日本陆海军当局随即发表了一份强硬声明。该文件表达了这些当局决心采取“有效且适当的措施，从根源上铲除导致极司菲尔路枪击事件的‘祸患’”。

除日本陆海军联合声明外，路透社昨晚转载的一则东京报道称，“维新政府外交部”已制定出一项关于交还上海国际租界的计划，将其作为解决中国国际租界及外国在华租界问题的根本方案。

（批：fu (23/8)）

"The Council acknowledges the

municipal road of an armed
body of Shanghai Special Muni-
cipal Government police and as

报道续称，此举是极司菲尔路枪击事件的后续。消息补充说，该方案将提交给“维新政府”的“行政委员会”批准。
以下是工部局声明的全文：
“工部局确认收到上海特别市政府于1939年8月21日发出的照会，该照会系针对8月19日（星期六）在极司菲尔路发生的令人遗憾的事件而写。
“经工部局仔细审查的证据表明，事件责任在于贵方行政机构的警察，而负责上海公共租界警务处小组的金洛克巡长无可指责。
“金洛克巡长在履行职责过程中，询问一支武装的上海特别市政府警察队伍出现在市政道路上的原因及其目的地。在他进行询问时，他遭到上海特别市政府警察队伍中一人的无端射击并受伤，而该队伍其余成员则将步枪瞄准了他。金洛克巡长随即装弹，出于自卫并为驱散正瞄准他的这群人而开枪。
“工部局认为，不仅必须否认对发生的不幸事件承担责任，而且必须就上海特别市政府警察的行为向贵方提出抗议。为了和平与秩序，贵方行政机构显然必须采取步骤，防止此类事件在上海公共租界警务处合法巡逻的市政道路上再次发生。
“工部局完全确信，调查结果所获得的证据充分支持上述结论。如果上海特别市政府对工部局的事实认定提出异议，工部局倾向于同意由双方商定的个人或人员进行公正调查。”
“深切关注”
日本陆海军当局昨晚发表的联合声明指出，“日军对该事件深感关切”，随后补充道：
“日军此前曾在一份面向国内外发布的联合声明中宣布，将支持并与维新政府，特别是与上海特别市合作。
“尽管有此声明，但在受英国影响的上海公共租界工部局管辖下的公共道路上，仍发生了针对特别市警察的这一事件，这证明英国不承认实际局势。”

Disinterested Inquiry
Into Jessfield Incident
Offered By S.M. Council

GOVERNMENT SAYS COUNCIL THINKS
S. M. POLICE PARTY NOT TO BLAME

Japanese Army Officers Hold Important Meeting

The Shanghai Municipal Council replied late yesterday

Government protesting to the Council in connection with the
incident which took place on Jessfield Road on Saturday,
August 19.

The full text of the Council's reply is as follows:—

"The Council acknowledges the receipt of the despatch of
the Shanghai Special Municipal Government dated August 21,
1939, written with reference to the regrettable incident which
took place in Jessfield Road on Saturday, August 19.

"It appears clear from the evi-
dence, which has been care-
fully examined by the Council,
that the responsibility for the in-
cident rests upon the Police of your
Administration, and that no blame
can be attached to Sergeant Kin-
loch, who was in charge of the
Shanghai Municipal Police party.
Sergeant Kinlock, in pursuance of
his duties, inquired the reason for
the presence upon a Municipal road
of an armed body of Shanghai Spe-
cial Municipal Government Police
and as to their destination. While
he was conducting his inquiries, he
was fired upon without provocation
and wounded by one of the Shang-
hai Special Municipal Government
Police party, while the remainder
of the Shanghai Special Municipal
Government Police party trained
their rifles upon him. Sergeant
Kinloch thereupon loaded his gun
and fired in self-defence and in
order to disperse the party which
was taking aim at him.

Repudiate Responsibility

"The Council feels bound not only
to repudiate responsibility for the
unfortunate occurrence which took
place but also to protest to you
against the conduct of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government
Police. In the interests of peace
and order it is manifestly impera-
tive that steps be taken by your
Administration to prevent the re-
currence of such incidents upon
Municipal roads which are lawfully
patrolled by the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Police.

"The Council is fully convinced
from the evidence resulting from
its investigation that the facts fully
support its conclusions as above
set forth. If the Council's findings
of fact are disputed by the Shang-
hai Special Municipal Government
the Council is disposed to agree to
a disinterested inquiry by such
person or persons as may be
agreed upon."

《上海泰晤士报》。

1939年8月23日

工部局提议
对极司菲尔路事件
进行公正调查

昨晚致函市政府的回复称，工部局认为
上海公共租界警务处小组并无过错

金洛克巡长先受伤
仅出于自卫开枪

日本军官举行重要会议
讨论措施；南京维新政府
考虑采取行动

上海公共租界工部局于昨晚深夜回复了上海特别市政府的照会，后者就8月19日（星期六）在极司菲尔路发生的事件向工部局提出抗议。

工部局回复的全文如下：—

“工部局确认收到上海特别市政府于1939年8月21日发出的照会，该照会系针对8月19日（星期六）在极司菲尔路发生的令人遗憾的事件而写。

“经工部局仔细审查的证据表明，事件责任在于贵方行政机构的警察，而负责上海公共租界警务处小组的金洛克巡长无可指责。金洛克巡长在履行职责过程中，询问一支武装的上海特别市政府警察队伍出现在市政道路上的原因及其目的地。在他进行询问时，他遭到上海特别市政府警察队伍中一人的无端射击并受伤，而该队伍其余成员则将步枪瞄准了他。金洛克巡长随即装弹，出于自卫并为驱散正瞄准他的这群人而开枪。

否认责任

“工部局认为，不仅必须否认对发生的不幸事件承担责任，而且必须就上海特别市政府警察的行为向贵方提出抗议。为了和平与秩序，贵方行政机构显然必须采取步骤，防止此类事件在上海公共租界警务处合法巡逻的市政道路上再次发生。

“工部局完全确信，调查结果所获得的证据充分支持上述结论。如果上海特别市政府对工部局的事实认定提出异议，工部局倾向于同意由双方商定的个人或人员进行公正调查。”

Japanese Notified
The Council received yesterday a protest in connection with the same incident from the Japanese Consul-General. The Japanese Consul-General has been notified of the nature of the Council's reply to the Shanghai Special Municipal Government and of the Council's willingness that the whole of the evidence should be examined by a disinterested inquiry.

Military Confers
Japanese Army officers held an important meeting Monday night to discuss measures to be taken in connection with the Jessfield Road shooting incident, the "Tairiku Shimpo" said yesterday.
The meeting opened at 5 o'clock and lasted three hours. The officers were said by the paper to have decided that the Japanese Army could not permit a settlement of the incident to be delayed. The meeting was held at the headquarters of the Japanese Army Special Service Section.
Present were three staff officers of the Japanese Expeditionary Force to Central China and three officers representing the local forces.

Nanking's Attitude
NANKING, Aug. 22.—A bill for the purpose of seeking the establishment of the Reformed Government's "legal rights" in the Shanghai International Settlement was drafted at a second meeting of Foreign Ministry officials yesterday.
The action was taken in connection with the shooting incident in the western district of Shanghai last Saturday night.
Officials of the Foreign Ministry will take immediate steps to recover "legal rights" in the International Settlement after the bill is passed at an administrative meeting Thursday, it was announced today.
"The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is determined to effect a solution not only of the Jessfield Road incident but also of the entire Settlement question," Mr. Hsia Chi-feng, Minister of Foreign Affairs, declared.

"Provocative Action"
"An outrageous incident of this kind is certain to lead to further massacres of Chinese people by Shanghai Municipal police unless a fundamental solution of it is effected."
"This incident is an insult to the Reformed Government. At the same time it is a provocative action which tends to lead to similar incidents.
"We have had two urgent ministerial conferences and dispatched an official to Shanghai to inquire into the facts of the incident."
Meanwhile the Ta Min Hui was taking active steps to marshal public support behind the Reformed Government in its plans to seek a solution of the International Settlement question. The society sent telegrams to many sections of the country.
The Ta Min Hui issued a declaration that it was launching a movement to "mobilize the people" to recover the International Settlement.—Domei.

日方提出照会
工部局昨日收到日本总领事就同一事件提出的抗议书。已通知日本总领事，工部局回复上海特别市政府的性质，以及工部局愿意由公正的调查机构审查全部证据。

军方磋商
据《大陆新报》昨日称，日本陆军军官周一晚举行重要会议，讨论针对极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）枪击事件应采取的措施。
会议于5时开始，持续了三小时。据该报称，与会军官决定，日本陆军不能允许该事件的解决被拖延。会议在日本陆军特务机关总部举行。
出席会议的有日本华中派遣军的三名参谋军官，以及代表当地部队的三名军官。

南京方面态度
南京，8月22日电——外交部官员昨日在第二次会议上起草了一项法案，旨在寻求确立维新政府在上海公共租界的“合法权利”。
此举与上周六晚上海西区发生的枪击事件有关。
今日宣布，在该法案于周四行政会议通过后，外交部官员将立即采取措施，收回在公共租界内的“合法权利”。
外交部长夏奇峰（Hsia Chi-feng，音译）宣称：“外交部决心不仅解决极司菲尔路事件，还要解决整个租界问题。”

“挑衅行为”
“如果不从根本上解决此类骇人听闻的事件，必将导致上海公共租界巡捕进一步屠杀中国人。”
“此事件是对维新政府的侮辱。同时，这也是一种可能导致类似事件再次发生的挑衅行为。”
“我们已召开两次紧急部长级会议，并派遣一名官员前往上海调查事件真相。”
与此同时，大民会正积极采取行动，动员公众支持维新政府解决公共租界问题的计划。该协会向全国多地发送了电报。
大民会发表声明，称其正在发起一场“动员民众”以收回公共租界的运动。——同盟社

Japanese Press Comment
"Solution of the Jessfield Road
shooting incident requires thorough
measures for the purpose of eradi-
cating the hostile character of the
International Settlement," the
Shanghai "Mainichi" declared
editorially yesterday.
"Physical force is required, not
such lukewarm measures as de-
mands for punishment of the per-
petrators, a guarantee against sim-
ilar incidents in the future, or com-
pensation of the victims—mere per-
functory steps taken heretofore in
similar cases," the usually conserva-
tive Japanese newspaper said.
"In this case it is not necessary
to go into the question of which
side was to blame; it is sufficient
to take up the matter of police of
an established Government being
assaulted and shot dead.
"It is scarcely necessary to point
out that the Settlement of Shang-
hai, which was used by the Chin-
ese forces as their base, should
have come under the control of the
Japanese forces at the time of their
occupation of this area. And this
argument applies to the situation
today.
"The present system and func-
tions of the Settlement are of such
a character as to make them sub-
ject to the approval of the Japan-
ese forces, no matter whether the
Japanese forces explicitly claim that
right.
"Liquidation" Possible
"If, therefore, the Japanese forces
think it necessary to do so they
can unilaterally effect the liquida-
tion of the Settlement.
"And indeed if they do not go
to the bottom of the problem there
can be no expectation of bringing
about a fundamental solution of it.
"As it can be said that the Shang-
hai Special Municipality police are
engaged in the maintenance of
peace and order in a prescribed area
around Shanghai under the com-
mission, as it were, of the Japan-
ese forces, insult, injury, or murder
committed against them at the
hands of the Shanghai Municipal
police means that such acts are
committed against the Japanese
forces themselves.
"When the Japanese proposed a
speedy disposal of such organs of
the Chungking Government as the
Special District Courts, banks and
the like in the Settlement, it was
reported that the Chungking Gov-
ernment was strongly perturbed
over the matter.
S.M.C. "Perturbed"
"But it seems that the S.M.C. au-
thorities were perturbed at great
deal more than the Chungking
Government, as was evidenced, for
example, by the stationing of Brit-
ish soldiers inside and outside of
the courts.
"The hostile character, overt and
covert, of the Settlement has been
witnessed so often in the past; and
the too moderate attitude on the
part of the Japanese forces has
brought about such an incident as
that of Saturday evening.
"It is earnestly hoped that de-
finite action, more than mere pro-
tests, will be taken by the Japan-
ese authorities for the purpose of
extirpating the hostile character of
the Settlement."

日本报刊评论
“解决极司菲尔路
枪击事件需要采取彻底
措施，以根除公
共租界的敌对性质，”
上海《每日新闻》昨
日在社论中宣称。
“需要的是武力，而
非诸如要求惩办肇事
者、保证今后不再发
生类似事件或赔偿受
害者等温吞措施——这
些不过是以往在类似
案件中采取的敷衍步
骤，”这家通常持保守
立场的日本报纸称。
“在此案中，无需深
究哪一方有过错；只
需关注既定政府的警
察遭到袭击并被枪杀
这一事实即可。
“几乎无需指出，曾
被中国军队用作基地
的上海租界，本应在
日军占领该地区时即
置于日军控制之下。
这一论点同样适用于
当前局势。
“租界目前的体制和
职能具有这样的性质：
无论日军是否明确主
张这一权利，它们都
须受制于日军的认可。
‘清算’成为可能
“因此，如果日军认
为有必要，他们可以
单方面实施对租界的
清算。
“的确，如果他们不
深入探究问题的根本，
就不可能指望带来根
本性的解决。
“既然可以说上海特
别市警察是在日军委
任下，负责维持上海
周边指定区域的和平
与秩序，那么上海公
共租界巡捕对他们实
施的侮辱、伤害或谋
杀，就意味着这些行
为是针对日军本身实
施的。
“当日方提议迅速处
置租界内重庆政府的
相关机构，如特区法
院、银行等时，据报
道重庆政府对此事感
到强烈不安。
工部局‘不安’
“但似乎工部局当局
比重庆政府更为不安，
例如在英国士兵部署
于法院内外这一点上
便可见证。
“租界公开及隐蔽的
敌对性质在过去已屡
见不鲜；而日军过于
温和的态度导致了周
六晚间这样的事件。
“恳切希望日本当局
采取确切行动，而不
仅仅是抗议，以根除
租界的敌对性质。”

A PRESS
AUG 23 1939

Miura Sends
Strong Note
To Franklin

Says Rights Of S.M.P.
North Of Creek Not
To Be Restored

Japanese authorities have decided to postpone the restoration of the full rights of Shanghai Municipal Police to function in areas north of Soochow Creek because of the Jessfield Road shooting of last Saturday. This is according to a note forwarded to Mr. C. S. Franklin, Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council by Yoshiaki Miura, Japanese Consul General yesterday afternoon.

The reason for this action, according to Miura's note, is because the Jessfield Road affair raised a question of confidence in the Settlement police. The note also declared that the Japanese authorities take a "most serious view" of the incident and reserve the right to make further representations and to take such measures as may be necessary to "eradicate the fundamental causes which led to the occurrence of this deplorable event." The text of Miura's note follows:

"Unfortunate Incident"

"I have the honor to refer to the unfortunate incident which took place on Jessfield Road on the afternoon of August 19, 1939 in which armed police of the Municipal Council shot to death two of the members of the police of the City Government of Shanghai and injured several others.

"The most careful and detailed investigations were conducted by the Japanese authorities and, as the result, it has been revealed that the responsibility lies entirely with the Municipal Police. It has been the practice of the police of the City Government of Shanghai to pass along the Extension Roads heretofore, and notwithstanding this, Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kinloch of the Municipal Police suddenly fired, on Jessfield Road, sub-machine gun shots against members of the police of the City Government on the afternoon of August 19, without any provocation at all on the part of the latter. The case should, therefore, be regarded in no other way than an act of outrageous and atrocious attack on members of the police City Government, which is unmistakably an act ultra vires.

A PRESS
1939年8月23日

三浦向
富兰克林
发出强硬
照会

称苏州河以北
上海公共租界巡捕
权利不予恢复

由于上周六发生的极司菲尔路枪击事件，日本当局决定推迟恢复上海公共租界巡捕在苏州河以北地区行使职权的完整权利。这是根据日本总领事三浦义明（Yoshiaki Miura）昨日下午转发给上海工部局董事会主席 C. S. 富兰克林先生的一份照会得知的。

根据三浦的照会，采取这一行动的原因是极司菲尔路事件引发了对租界巡捕的信任问题。照会还宣称，日本当局对该事件持“最严重之看法”，并保留作出进一步交涉以及采取必要措施以“根除导致这一不幸事件发生的根本原因”的权利。三浦照会全文如下：

“不幸事件”

“本人谨提及1939年8月19日下午发生在极司菲尔路的不幸事件，当时工部局武装巡捕枪杀了两名上海市政府巡捕，并致伤其他数人。

“日本当局进行了极其仔细和详细的调查，结果显示责任完全在于公共租界巡捕。上海市政府巡捕以往一直通行于越界筑路区域，尽管如此，1939年8月19日下午，公共租界巡捕见习警长 W. L. Kinloch 在极司菲尔路突然向上海市政府巡捕成员发射冲锋枪子弹，而后者并未有任何挑衅行为。因此，该案只能被视为对上海市政府巡捕成员的 outrageous and atrocious（残暴且恶劣）攻击，这无疑是一种越权行为。

pages.en:
23974

Take Most Serious View
"The Japanese authorities take a most serious view over what happened from the point of view of maintaining peace and order in and outside the International Settlement. While reserving the right to make further representations and to take such measures as may be necessary to eradicate the fundamental causes which led to the occurrence of this deplorable event, I have to bring the following to your notice.
"The Japanese authorities have been looking forward to the days when the function of the Municipal Police will have been resumed in the area north of the Soochow Creek and the area returned to the normal condition as early as possible. However, now that such violence as has been witnessed having been conducted by the Municipal Police, the very existence which is responsible for maintaining peace and order in the Settlement, they cannot but be compelled to feel that the confidence in the Municipal Police has been called in question. Consequently the Japanese authorities are unable to admit the immediate return of the Municipal Police to the area north of the Soochow Creek, having been left with no choice but to postpone it for the time being."
pages.zh:
23974

持最严重之看法
“从维持公共租界内外和平与秩序的角度来看，日本当局对所发生之事持最严重之看法。在保留作出进一步交涉以及采取必要措施以根除导致这一不幸事件发生的根本原因的权利的同时，本人须提请贵方注意以下事项。
“日本当局一直期待公共租界巡捕在苏州河以北地区的职能得以恢复，并使该地区尽早回归正常状态。然而，既然目睹了作为负责维持租界和平与秩序之主体的公共租界巡捕实施了此类暴力行为，他们不得不感到对公共租界巡捕的信任已受到质疑。因此，日本当局无法同意公共租界巡捕立即返回苏州河以北地区，别无选择，只能暂时推迟此事。”

Japanese
Army, Navy
Statement

Jessfield Road Incident
Regarded As Being
Very Grave

and appropriate measures to eradi-
cate at the roots the evils" respon-
sible for the Jessfield Road shooting
incident was expressed in a joint
statement issued by Japanese mili-
tary and naval authorities here yes-
terday evening.

"The Japanese forces are gravely

"over the incident that took place
at the corner of Sukiang Lu, Jess-
field Road on Saturday evening in
which a Probationary Sergeant of
the Shanghai Municipal Police
killed and wounded with a machine
gun a number of policemen of the

"The Japanese forces some time

to and co-operate with the Reform-
ed Government, and especially with

Blame On Britain

"And it is proof of the non-

place against police of the Special

"Now that the Japanese forces
have occupied the areas surrounding
Shanghai, and the regime of General

rid of hostile agitators who are dis-

tlement, and thus co-operate along

"Therefore, all the authority of

《上海泰晤士报》

1938年8月2日

日本
陆海军
声明

视极司菲尔路
事件为
非常严重

昨日傍晚，驻沪日本军政当局发表联合声明，表示决心采取“有效且适当的措施，从根源上铲除”导致极司菲尔路枪击事件的“弊恶”。

声明称：“日军对周六晚间在极司菲尔路与松江路（Sukiang Lu）转角处发生的事件深感关切，事件中一名上海公共租界巡捕见习警长用机枪杀伤多名上海特别市警察。

“日军此前曾在一份向国内外发布的联合声明中宣布，将支持并与维新政府，特别是与上海特别市合作。

归咎英国

“尽管有此声明，但在公共道路上仍发生了针对特别市警察的这一事件，这证明了对上海工部局施加影响的英国方面不承认实际事态。

“既然日军已占领上海周边地区，且蒋介石将军的政权已沦为一个小型地方行政机构，租界当局应清除扰乱租界和平与秩序的敌对煽动分子，从而在各条战线上与日军合作。

“因此，租界内存在的重庆政府的所有权力，应由日军及受日军支持的政府行使。

“从这个 standpoint（立场）出发，日军视此事件为非常严重，并决心采取有效且适当的措施，从根源上铲除导致该事件的弊恶。”

Chungking Government existing in
the Settlement should be exercised by
the Japanese forces and the govern-
ment which is supported by the
Japanese forces.
"From this standpoint the Japanese
forces regard the incident as very
grave, and are determined to take
effective and appropriate measures to
eradicate at the roots the evils which
brought it about."

Council Answers Mayor Fu

The Shanghai Municipal Council
replied late yesterday evening to the
despatch of the Shanghai Special
Municipal Government protesting to
the Council in connection with the
incident which took place on Jessfield
Road on Saturday, August 19. The
full text of the Council's reply is as
follows:—
"The Council acknowledges the
receipt of the despatch of the Shang-
hai Special Municipal Government
dated August 21, 1939, written with
reference to the regrettable incident
which took place in Jessfield Road on
Saturday, August 19.
"It appears clear from the evidence,
which has been carefully examined by
the Council, that the responsibility
for the incident rests upon the Police
of your Administration, and that no
blame can be attached to Sergeant
Kinloch, who was in charge of the
Shanghai Municipal Police party.
Sergeant Kinloch, in pursuance of his
duties, enquired the reason for the
presence upon a Municipal road of
an armed body of Shanghai Special
Municipal Government Police and as
to their destination. While he was
conducting his enquiries, he was fired
upon without provocation and wound-
ed by one of the Shanghai Special
Municipal Government Police party,
while the remainder of the Shanghai
Special Municipal Government Police
party trained their rifles upon him.
Sergeant Kinloch thereupon loaded
his gun and fired in self-defence and
in order to disperse the party which
was taking aim at him."
pages.zh:
1939年8月20日
日军将就极司菲尔路枪击案采取行动

指责租界当局容许煽动分子活动；市长抗议遭拒

日本海陆军当局昨晚发表联合声明，表示决心采取“有效且适当的措施，从根源上铲除”导致极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）枪击事件的祸患。声明称：“日军对周六晚3时45分发生在极司菲尔路新康里（Hsin-kangli）入口处的事件深感关切，在该事件中，上海公共租界工部局警务处的一名试用巡长使用机枪杀伤了数名上海特别市政府警察。”

“日军此前曾在一份向国内外发布的联合声明中宣布，将支持并与‘维新政府’，特别是与上海特别市政府进行合作。
“尽管有此声明，但在公共道路上仍发生了针对特别市政府警察的此类事件，这证明了受英国影响的上海工部局不承认实际事态。”

要求合作

“既然日军已占领上海周边地区，而蒋介石将军的政权已沦为一个地方小行政机构，租界当局就应清除扰乱租界和平与秩序的敌对煽动分子，从而在各条战线上与日军合作。
“因此，存在于租界内的重庆政府的一切权力，应由日军及受日军支持的政府行使。
“从这个立场出发，日军认为该事件非常严重，并决心采取有效和适当的措施，从根源上铲除引发该事件的祸患。”

工部局答复傅市长

上海工部局于昨晚深夜回复了上海特别市政府就8月19日（星期六）极司菲尔路发生的事件向工部局提出的抗议照会。工部局回复全文如下：
“工部局确认收到上海特别市政府1939年8月21日的照会，该照会提及8月19日（星期六）在极司菲尔路发生的令人遗憾的事件。
“经工部局仔细审查证据，显然该事件的责任在于贵方行政当局的警察，而负责上海公共租界工部局警务处队伍的 Kinloch 巡长无可指责。Kinloch 巡长在履行职责期间，询问一队武装的上海特别市政府警察出现在工部局道路上的原因及其目的地。在他进行询问时，他遭到上海特别市政府警察队伍中一人的无端射击并受伤，而该队伍其余成员则将步枪瞄准了他。Kinloch 巡长随即装弹开枪，以自卫并驱散正瞄准他的那队人员。”

pages.en:
24005

"Ta Tao" Police Blamed
"The Council feels bound not only to repudiate responsibility for the unfortunate occurrence which took place but also to protest to you against the conduct of the Shanghai Special Municipal Government Police. In the interests of peace and order it is manifestly imperative that steps be taken by your Administration to prevent the recurrence of such incidents upon Municipal roads which are lawfully patrolled by the Shanghai Municipal Police.
"The Council is fully convinced from the evidence resulting from its investigation that the facts fully support its conclusions as above set forth. If the Council's findings of fact are disputed by the Shanghai Special Municipal Government the Council is disposed to agree to a disinterested inquiry by such person or persons as may be agreed upon."
The Council received yesterday a protest in connection with the same incident from the Japanese Consul-General. The Japanese Consul-General has been notified of the nature of the Council's reply to the Shanghai Special Municipal Government and of the Council's willingness that the whole of the evidence should be examined by a disinterested inquiry.

Japanese Note to S.M.C.
Japanese authorities were unable to permit the immediate restoration to the Shanghai Municipal police of the right to function in areas north of Soochow Creek, and had decided to postpone the matter for the time being, because the shooting incident on Jessfield Road last Saturday evening raised a question of confidence in the municipal police, Mr. Yoshiaki Miura, Japanese Consul-General, declared in a note addressed to Mr. C. S. Franklin, Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council, yesterday.
The Japanese authorities took a "most serious view" of the incident and reserved the right to make further representations and to take such measures as may be necessary to "eradicate the fundamental causes which led to the occurrence of this deplorable event," the note stated.
The shooting, the note declared, was regarded as an outrageous and atrocious attack on members of the police of the City Government.
Dispatching of the note to Mr. Franklin by Mr. Miura was announced in a statement issued by the Japanese Consulate-General last night.
Mr. Miura's note follows:
pages.zh:
24005

指责“大道”政府警察

“工部局感到不仅有责任否认对这一不幸事件承担责任，而且还要就上海特别市政府警察的行为向贵方提出抗议。为了和平与秩序，贵方行政当局显然必须采取措施，防止此类事件在由上海公共租界工部局警务处依法巡逻的工部局道路上再次发生。
“工部局完全确信，调查所得证据充分支持上述结论。如果上海特别市政府对工部局的事实认定提出异议，工部局愿意同意由双方商定的公正人士进行独立调查。”
工部局昨日还收到了日本总领事就同一事件提出的抗议。日本总领事已获知工部局对上海特别市政府回复的性质，以及工部局愿意由公正人士审查全部证据的态度。

日本致工部局照会

日本当局无法允许上海公共租界警务处立即恢复在苏州河以北地区的职能，并决定暂时推迟此事，因为上周六晚极司菲尔路的枪击事件引发了对市警的信任问题，日本总领事三浦义秋（Yoshiaki Miura）先生在昨日致上海工部局主席 C. S. Franklin 先生的照会中宣称。
照会称，日本当局对该事件持“最严肃的看法”，并保留作出进一步交涉以及采取必要措施以“铲除导致这一可悲事件发生的根本原因”的权利。
照会宣称，此次枪击被视为对市政府警察成员的猖狂且残暴的袭击。
日本总领事馆昨晚发表声明，宣布三浦先生已向 Franklin 先生发出照会。
三浦先生的照会如下：

pages.en:
24006

S. M. P. Responsible
"I have the honour to refer to the unfortunate incident which took place on Jessfield Road on the afternoon of August 19, 1939 in which armed police of the Municipal Council shot to death two of the members of the police of the City Government of Shanghai and injured several others.
"The most careful and detailed investigations were conducted by the Japanese authorities and, as the result, it has been revealed that the responsibility lies entirely with the Municipal Police. It has been the practice of the police of the City Government of Shanghai to pass along the Extension Roads heretofore, and notwithstanding this, Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kinloch of the Municipal Police suddenly fired, on Jessfield Road, sub-machine gun shots against members of the police of the City Government on the afternoon of August 19, without any provocation at all on the part of the latter. The case should, therefore, be regarded in no other way than an act of outrageous and atrocious attack on members of the City
the City Government, which is unmistakably an act ultra vires.

Serious View Taken
"The Japanese authorities take a most serious view over what happened from the point of view of maintaining peace and order in and outside the International Settlement. While reserving the right to make further representations and to take such measures as may be necessary to eradicate the fundamental causes which led to the occurrence of this deplorable event, I have to bring the following to your notice.
"The Japanese authorities have been looking forward to the days when the function of the Municipal Police will have been resumed in the area north of the Soochow Creek and the area returned to the normal condition as early as possible. However, now that such a violence as has been witnessed having been conducted by the Municipal Police, the very existence which is responsible for maintaining peace and order in the Settlement, they cannot but be compelled to feel that the confidence in the Municipal Police has been called in question. Consequently the Japanese authorities are unable, to admit the immediate return of the Municipal Police to the area north of the Soochow Creek, having been left with no choice but to postpone it for the time being."
pages.zh:
24006

市警负有责任

“本人谨提及1939年8月19日下午发生在极司菲尔路的不幸事件，在该事件中，工部局的武装警察射杀了两名上海市政府警察成员，并致伤其他数人。
“日本当局进行了最为仔细和详细的调查，结果显示，责任完全在于市警。上海市政府警察以往一直习惯通行于越界筑路区域，尽管如此，市警试用巡长 W. L. Kinloch 于8月19日下午在极司菲尔路突然向市政府警察成员发射冲锋枪子弹，而后者并未有任何挑衅行为。因此，该案只能被视为对市政府成员的猖狂且残暴的袭击，这无疑是一种越权行为。

持严肃看法

“从维持国际租界内外和平与秩序的角度来看，日本当局对所发生之事持最严肃的看法。在保留作出进一步交涉以及采取必要措施以铲除导致这一可悲事件发生的根本原因的权利的同时，本人须提请阁下注意以下事项。
“日本当局一直期待市警职能能在苏州河以北地区恢复，并使该地区尽早恢复正常状态。然而，既然目睹了作为负责维持租界和平与秩序之存在的市警实施了此类暴力行为，他们不得不感到对市警的信任已受到质疑。因此，日本当局无法允许市警立即返回苏州河以北地区，别无选择，只能暂时推迟。”

pages.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,
23997
AUG 23 1939

Settlement Called
"Hostile"

Local Japanese Journal
Urges Use of Force to
Solve Problem

"Solution of the Jessfield Road
shooting incident requires thorough
measures for the purpose of eradicat-
ing the hostile character of the Inter-
national Settlement," the "Shanghai
Mainichi" declared editorially.

"Physical force is required, not such
lukewarm measures as demands for
punishment of the perpetrators, a
guarantee against similar incidents in
the future, or compensation of the
victims—were perfunctory steps taken
heretofore in similar cases," the
usually conservative Japanese news-
paper said.

"In this case it is not necessary to
go into the question of which side was
to blame; it is sufficient to take up
the matter of police of an established
Government being assaulted and shot
dead.

"It is scarcely necessary to point
out that the Settlement of Shanghai,
which was used by the Chinese forces
as their base, should have come under
the control of the Japanese forces at
the time of their occupation of this
area. And this argument applies to
the situation today.

Japanese "Right" Asserted

"The present system and functions
of the Settlement are of such a char-
acter as to make them subject to the
approval of the Japanese forces, no
matter whether the Japanese forces
explicitly claim that right.

"If, therefore, the Japanese forces
think it necessary to do so they can
unilaterally effect the liquidation of
the Settlement.

"And indeed if they do not go to
the bottom of the problem, there can
be no expectation of bringing about
a fundamental solution of it.

"As it can be said that the Shanghai
Special Municipality police are en-
gaged in the maintenance of peace
and order in a prescribed area
around Shanghai under the commis-
sion, as it were, of the Japanese
forces, insult, injury, or murder com-
mitted against them at the hands of
the Shanghai Municipal Police means
that such acts are committed against
the Japanese forces themselves.

Perturbation Alleged

"When the Japanese proposed a
speedy disposal of such organs of the
Chungking Government as the special
district courts, banks and the like in
the Settlement, it was reported that
the Chungking Government was
strongly perturbed over the matter.

"But it seems that the S.M.C. au-
thorities were perturbed a great deal
more than the Chungking Govern-
ment, as was evidenced, for example,
by the stationing of British soldiers
inside and outside of the courts.

"The hostile character, overt and
covert, of the Settlement has been
witnessed so often in the past; and
the too moderate attitude on the part
of the Japanese forces has brought
about such an incident as that of
Saturday evening.

"It is earnestly hoped that definite
action, more than mere protests, will
be taken by the Japanese authorities
for the purpose of extirpating the
hostile character of the Settlement."
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，
23997
1939年8月23日

称租界具有
“敌对性”

当地日文报纸
敦促使用武力
解决问题

“解决极司菲尔路枪击事件需要采取彻底措施，以铲除国际租界的敌对性质，”《上海每日新闻》在社论中宣称。

“需要使用武力，而不是像惩罚肇事者、保证未来不再发生类似事件或赔偿受害者这类温吞的措施——这些是在类似案件中以往采取的敷衍步骤，”这家通常保守的日本报纸说道。

“在此案中，没有必要深入探讨哪一方有过错；只需关注既定政府的警察遭受袭击并被射杀这一事实即可。

“几乎无需指出，曾被中国军队用作基地的上海租界，本应在日军占领该地区时置于日军控制之下。这一论点同样适用于当今局势。

主张日本“权利”

“无论日军是否明确主张这一权利，租界目前的体制和职能都具有须受日军批准的性质。

“因此，如果日军认为有必要，他们可以单方面实现租界的清算。

“的确，如果不从根本上解决问题，就不可能期望带来根本性的解决方案。

“可以说，上海特别市政府警察是在日军的委任下，负责维持上海周边指定区域的和平与秩序，因此，上海公共租界工部局警务处对他们实施的侮辱、伤害或谋杀，意味着这些行为是针对日军本身实施的。

声称引起不安

“当日方提议迅速处置租界内诸如特区法院、银行等重庆政府机构时，据报道重庆政府对此事深感不安。

“但似乎工部局当局比重庆政府更为不安，例如在法院内外部署英军士兵便证明了这一点。

“租界公开和隐蔽的敌对性质在过去已屡见不鲜；而日军过于温和的态度导致了周六晚这样的事件。

“恳切希望日本当局采取果断行动，而不仅仅是抗议，以铲除租界的敌对性质。”

23988
SHANGHAI TIMES.
AUG 23 1939

Repercussion
Of Jessfield
Affair Grows

Strong Letter Sent By
Japanese Consul-Gen.
To Mr. Franklin

AREAS NORTH OF CREEK
TO BE LONGER HELD

A new development in the
situation arising out of the
incident on Jessfield Road on
Saturday night took place yes-
terday, when Mr. Y. Miura,
Japanese Consul-General, sent
a letter to Mr. C. S. Franklin,
Chairman of the S.M.C., saying
that, in consequence of the
incident the return to the
Council's control of the area
north of the Soochow Creek
would have to be postponed for
the time being.
The text of Mr. Miura's letter
was as follows:
"I have the honour to refer to
the unfortunate incident which
took place on Jessfield Road on the
afternoon of August 19, 1939, in
which armed police of the Muni-
cipal Council shot to death two of
the members of the police of the
City Government of Shanghai and
injured several others.
"The most careful and detailed
investigations were conducted by
the Japanese authorities and, as
the result, it has been revealed that
the responsibility lies entirely with
the Municipal Police. It has been
the practice of the police of the
City Government of Shanghai to pass
along the extension roads hereto-
fore, and notwithstanding this,
Probationary Sergeant W. L. Kin-
loch, of the Municipal Police, sud-
denly fired, on Jessfield Road, sub-
machine gun shots against members
of the police of the City Govern-
ment on the afternoon of August 19,
without any provocation at all on
the part of the latter. The case
should, therefore, be regarded in
no other way than an act of out-
rageous and atrocious attack on
members of the police of the City
Government, which is unmistakably
an act ultra vires."

23988
《字林西报》。
1939年8月23日

极司菲尔路事件
余波扩大

日本总领事致富兰克林先生
措辞强硬之函件

苏州河以北地区
暂不交还

上周六晚发生在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）的事件所引发的局势新变化，于昨日出现新的进展。日本总领事三浦（Y. Miura）先生致函工部局董事会主席富兰克林（C. S. Franklin）先生，称鉴于该事件，将苏州河以北地区归还工部局管辖一事须暂时推迟。
三浦先生信函全文如下：
“本人谨就1939年8月19日下午发生在极司菲尔路的不幸事件提及此事，在该事件中，工部局武装警察枪杀了两名上海市政府警察成员，并致伤其他数人。
“日本当局进行了最为仔细和详细的调查，结果显示，责任完全在于工部局警察。上海市政府警察以往一直有通行延伸路段的习惯，尽管如此，工部局见习警长W. L. Kinloch于8月19日下午在极司菲尔路，在后者毫无挑衅的情况下，突然向上海市政府警察成员发射冲锋枪子弹。因此，该案只能被视为对上海市政府警察成员的野蛮残暴攻击，这显然是一种越权行为。”

pages.en:
23995
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,

AUG 23 1939

Nanking Seeking
"Legal Rights"
More Control Wanted in
Shanghai Settlement, Due
To Jessfield Shooting

Nanking, Aug. 22
A bill for the purpose of seeking
the establishment of the "Reformed
Government's" legal rights in the
Shanghai International Settlement
was drafted at a second meeting of
Foreign Ministry officials yesterday.
The action was taken in connection
with the shooting incident in the
western district of Shanghai last
Saturday night.
Officials of the Foreign Ministry
will take immediate steps to recover
"legal rights" in the International
Settlement after the bill is passed at
an administrative meeting Thursday,
it was announced today.
"The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is
determined to effect a solution not
only of the Jessfield Road incident
but also of the entire Settlement
question," Mr. Hsia Chi-feng, Minister
of Foreign Affairs, declared.

Further "Massacres" Feared

"An outrageous incident of this
kind is certain to lead to further
massacres of Chinese people by
Shanghai Municipal Police unless a
fundamental solution of it is effected.
"This incident is an insult to the
'Reformed Government.' At the
same time it is a provocative action
which tends to lead to similar inci-
dents.
"We have had two urgent ministeri-
al conferences and dispatched an
official to Shanghai to inquire into
the facts of the incident."
Meanwhile the Ta Min Hui was
taking active steps to marshal public
support behind the "Reformed Gov-
ernment" in its plans to seek a solu-
tion of the International Settlement
question. The society sent telegrams
to many sections of the country.
The Ta Min Hui issued a declara-
tion that it was launching a move-
ment to "mobilize the people" to re-
cover the International Settlement.--
Domei.
pages.zh:
23995
《字林西报》，

1939年8月23日

南京寻求
“法权”
因极司菲尔路枪击案
欲加强对上海租界的控制

南京，8月22日电
外交部官员昨日召开第二次会议，起草了一项旨在确立“维新政府”在上海国际租界内“法权”的法案。
此举与上周六晚发生在上海西区的枪击事件有关。
今日宣布，在该法案于周四行政会议上通过后，外交部官员将立即采取措施，收回在国际租界内的“法权”。
外交部长夏奇峰（Hsia Chi-feng，音译）先生宣称：“外交部决心不仅解决极司菲尔路事件，还要解决整个租界问题。”

担心进一步发生“屠杀”

“除非从根本上解决此类恶劣事件，否则上海工部局警察必定会对中国人进行进一步的屠杀。
“此事件是对‘维新政府’的侮辱。同时，这也是一种可能导致类似事件发生的挑衅行为。
“我们已召开两次紧急部长级会议，并派遣一名官员前往上海调查事件真相。”
与此同时，大民会正积极采取行动，动员公众支持“维新政府”寻求解决国际租界问题的计划。该协会向全国多地发送了电报。
大民会发表声明称，正在发起一场“动员民众”以收回国际租界的运动。——同盟社。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

AUG 2 1939

Police Patrols:
Do Japanese Take Part

To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"

SIR,—During the past few days
several shooting affrays have occurred
on outlying roads in the Western
District, the first was the ambushing
of three Chinese constables of the
S.M.P. of whom two were wounded
and Saturday last the shooting of a
foreign Probationary Sergeant.

In reports published I find that
these patrols consist of a foreigner,
presumably a Briton, and Chinese
Police Officers—why, I would like to
ask, are Japanese not included.

The writer has been informed that
there are about 100 Japanese Officers
attached to Hongkew Police Station
—what do they do, for if one takes
a tour of the Northern District very
very few of these officers are to be
seen.

According to your latest directory
there is a Foreign Branch, Section 2,
S.M.P. with over 250 names, these
Police Officers receive the same pay
as those under Section 1. why are
they not allowed to do the same work
and take the same risks of being
potted at from ambush. I fail to see
why these officers are not included
in these patrols. if they were, in all
probability there would be no more
shootings from ambush, etc., there-
fore making it safe for all concerned,
but perhaps the higher-ups can
answer that question.
PUZZLED.

Shanghai, Aug. 22.

《字林西报》，

1939年8月2日

警察巡逻：
日本人是否参与

致《字林西报》编辑

先生，——过去几天里，西区外围道路发生了几起枪战，第一起是三名华捕遭伏击，其中两人受伤；上周六则是一名外籍见习警长遭枪击。

我在发布的报道中发现，这些巡逻队由一名外国人（推测为英国人）和华籍警官组成——我想问，为何不包括日本人。

笔者获悉，约有100名日籍警官隶属于虹口警察局——他们在做什么？因为如果在北区巡视一番，几乎看不到这些警官的身影。

根据贵报最新名录，工部局警务处设有外侨科第二股（Foreign Branch, Section 2），名单超过250人，这些警官领取的薪金与第一股人员相同。为何不允许他们从事同样的工作，并承担同样被伏击射杀的风险？我不明白为何这些警官未被纳入巡逻队。如果纳入，很可能就不会再发生伏击射击等事件，从而使所有相关人员的安全得到保障，但或许高层人士能回答这个问题。
困惑者。

上海，8月22日。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY

AUG 21 1935

Kinloch Affair Causes
Propaganda In Nanking

(Domet).
NANKING, Aug. 21. — Anti-British feeling here was intensified today by reports of a shooting affray between Ta Tao police and the SMP in the western district of Shanghai, with civic organizations opposed to British policy demanding that the Shanghai Special Municipality take drastic measures against the Shanghai Municipal council.
Leaders of anti-British groups here claimed that the incident was an "insult" to the Reformed Government and an act of provocation by the Shanghai Municipal Council. Some agitators were demanding that Britons be "driven out of China."

The Ta Min Hui called an emergency mass meeting yesterday at which it was decided to launch a campaign to restore the Shanghai Settlement to Chinese control by "mobilizing the people."
The following statement was issued by Mr. Mi Tai-chang, Chairman of the Ta Min Hui:
"In the first place such incidents happen only because of the existence of foreign concessions and settlements. As a step to prevent any more incidents of this kind we demand the immediate return of foreign concessions. If our demands are not met we will mobilize the Chinese people to urge the Reformed Government to recover the concessions."

《上海晚邮报及信使报》

1935年8月21日

金洛克事件引发
南京宣传攻势

（同盟社）。
南京，8月21日电。——由于上海西区大道警察与工部局警务处（SMP）之间发生枪战的报道，这里的反英情绪今日加剧，反对英国政策的市民团体要求上海特别市对上海工部局采取严厉措施。
这里的反英团体领导人声称，该事件是对维新政府的“侮辱”，也是上海工部局的挑衅行为。一些煽动者要求将英国人“赶出中国”。

大民会昨日召开紧急群众大会，决定发起一场通过“动员民众”将上海租界收回中国控制的运动。
大民会主席米泰昌（Mi Tai-chang，音译）先生发表了如下声明：
“首先，此类事件的发生仅仅是因为外国租界和居留地的存在。为防止此类事件再次发生，我们要求立即归还外国租界。如果我们的要求得不到满足，我们将动员中国人民敦促维新政府收回租界。”

AUG 21 1939

SMP Heartened
By Resistance
To Ta Tao Men

Firm Council Policies

Ridicule Given Nippon

With Shanghai Municipal Police
and British military sentries
standing guard at the Country

W. L. Kinloch of the SMP was

Road near Connaught Road.
The remaining two survivors
of the four Ta Tao policemen hit

sub-machinegun were removed

《上海晚邮报及信使报》

1939年8月21日

工部局警务处因
抵抗大道警察
而士气大振

视在不良地带
实行坚定政策
为必要之举

警队内部
感到不满

对日方关于极司菲尔路
枪击案的说法予以嘲笑

随着上海工部局警务处（SMP）和英国军事哨兵在乡村医院（Country Hospital）站岗守卫，SMP见习警长W. L. Kinloch今日从周六傍晚在康纳路（Connaught Road）附近的极司菲尔路被一名大道警察团伙成员枪击造成的子弹创伤中顺利康复。
当Kinloch警长用汤普森冲锋枪还击时，四名被击中的大道警察中其余两名幸存者，昨日下午从山海关路警察医院转至福民医院。
Kinloch警长当场击毙一名大道警察，另一名腹部中四弹，受致命伤。
英勇行动
Kinloch警长的英勇行动鼓舞了SMP成员，他们最近因汇率下跌、回国休假路费减少以及在不良地带缺乏明确行动而感到非常沮丧，在那里他们被迫执勤并成为射击目标，而他们认为所得薪饷远不足够。

pages.en:
23852

Many, however, see the Shang
hai Municipal Council 'on the
spot' over the affair. If Kin-
loch's action is to be fully sup-
ported, positive action must be
taken in the western district. If
Kinloch should be sent home to
Britain, for his own safety, there
would be more discontent in the
force, from which there have
been a dozen resignations in re-
cent days, including the officers
in charge of three stations, with
others considering a like move.
Spares Two
Kinloch was riding, with four
Chinese constables, in one of the
Shanghai Volunteer Corps armor-
ed cars loaned to the SMC, when
he saw two civilians with pistols
accompanying a Ta Tao police
party. He and his party jumped
off the car, Kinloch carrying a
sub-machine gun, leaving the car
unarmed and unoccupied save by
its driver, and challenged one of
the unarmed Chinese.
The latter told Kinloch to
mind his own business, and tried
to seize the Thompson gun. At
the same time the other plain-
clothes man fired at Kinloch
from the back. Kinloch swung
his sub-machinegun, killed his
assailant, and sprayed the rest
of the party with bullets. Then,
in complete mastery of the situa-
tion, he refrained from killing
two of the Ta Tao party whom
he had cornered, in order to
avoid unnecessary bloodshed.
On Guard
Bubbling Well Station police
who were first on the scene in
reply to the alarm found Kinloch,
bleeding, standing on guard with
his Thompson fully reloaded and
ready for further trouble, with
his four Chinese constables group-
ed behind him. Chinese shop-
keepers in the vicinity were al-
ready putting up their shutters
in feverish haste.
Kinloch was taken to the Coun-
try Hospital, and the dead and
wounded Ta Tao men to the
Police Hospital, this being a mat-
ter of routine in shooting cases.
The surgeons, always ready for
emergencies, wasted no time in
doing their best for the Ta Tao
men, but one was beyond help.
Nippon Version Ridiculed
The Japanese army version of
the affair, in which the Nippon-
ese give their "reasons" for be-
lieving that the SMP fired first,
is ridiculed by informed circles.
One of the reasons states that
armored car No. 9, which Kin-
loch was using, was the same one
which was sent to the Ta Tao
police sub-station on Great West-
ern Road when the so-called flag-
pulling incident (allegedly done by
the late Mr. H. P. Krogh) took
place on July 7. Another reason
was that the "SMP suspected
that he (Krogh) had been killed
by members of the Ta Tao or-
ganization."
pages.zh:
23852

然而，许多人认为上海工部局在此事中处于“困境”。如果要全力支持Kinloch的行动，就必须在西区采取积极行动。如果为了Kinloch自身安全将其遣返英国，警队内部将出现更多不满，近日已有包括三个警局主管在内的十余人辞职，其他人也在考虑采取类似举动。
放过两人
Kinloch当时与四名华捕乘坐一辆借给工部局的上海义勇军装甲车，他看见两名持枪平民伴随一支大道警察队伍。他和手下跳下车，Kinloch手持冲锋枪，车上除司机外无人且未携带武器，并向一名未持武器的华人喝止。
后者告诉Kinloch少管闲事，并试图抢夺汤普森冲锋枪。与此同时，另一名便衣男子从背后向Kinloch开枪。Kinloch转动冲锋枪，击毙袭击者，并向该团伙其余成员扫射。随后，在完全掌控局势的情况下，为避免不必要的流血，他没有杀死已被逼入绝境的两名大道警察。
警戒
静安寺路警局警察最先接到警报赶到现场，发现Kinloch浑身是血，手持重新装满子弹的汤普森冲锋枪警戒，准备应对进一步的麻烦，四名华捕聚集在他身后。附近的华商店主已在慌乱中匆忙放下店门板。
Kinloch被送往乡村医院，死伤的大道警察被送往警察医院，这是枪击案件的常规程序。
外科医生随时准备应对紧急情况，毫不拖延地尽力救治大道警察，但其中一人已回天乏术。
对日方说法的嘲笑
知情圈子对日军关于此事的说法予以嘲笑，日方在其中给出了他们认为工部局警务处先开火的“理由”。其中一个理由是，Kinloch使用的9号装甲车，正是7月7日所谓“扯旗事件”（据称由已故的H. P. Krogh先生所为）发生时，被派往大西路大道警察分驻所的那辆车。另一个理由是，“工部局警务处怀疑他（Krogh）是被大道组织成员杀害的。”

pages.en:
23853

Informed quarters point out that
the alleged flag-pulling incident
did not take place on July 17 and
did not occasion any police turn-
out nor the presence of armored
cars: also, that following the sur-
reptitious reopening during the
night of July 16/17 of the Ta Tao
police station, no armored cars
attended the vicinity. Moreover,
the suspicion of the Ta Tao peo-
ple having murdered Mr. Krogh
can be accompanied by a pos-
sibility that the murder was done
by anti-Ta Tao agitators trying
to discredit the latter.
Hospitals
Reason number three of the
Japanese military states that the
"SMP took away the slightly
wounded lest the real facts of
the case be revealed," which is
ridiculed on the grounds that
any people needing medical at-
tention are always taken to hos-
pital in a fire department
emergency ambulance, and are not
left lying around on the streets
for questioning first, whatever
may be the practice elsewhere.
Reason number four quotes
the removal of the dead and
wounded to the Police Hospital
"in Yangtzepoo." The Police Hos-
pital in Wayside has not been
used since the start of hostilities
it is pointed out; it has been
occupying temporary quarters in
the Ellis Kadoorie School, Shan-
haikwan Road (off Carter Road),
for a long time now.
No Protest Yet
No special meeting of the
Shanghai Municipal Council has
been called to discuss the affair,
nor is the Council expected to is-
sue any statement on it, it was
learned this morning. No pro-
test has as yet been made over
the attack on Sergeant Kinloch.
Heavy police patrols continue
to patrol the badlands roads, as
they have done since the attack
on a patrol of three Chinese con-
stables on Amherst Avenue, where
two of the latter were wounded.
British military patrol trucks,
however, are now carrying Lewis
guns in addition to rifles.
pages.zh:
23853

据有关方面指出，所谓的扯旗事件并未在7月17日发生，也未引起任何警察出动或装甲车到场；此外，在7月16日至17日夜间大道警察局（Ta Tao police station）秘密重新开放后，附近也没有装甲车出现。而且，对于大道方面人员谋杀克罗格先生（Mr. Krogh）的嫌疑，还有一种可能性，即谋杀是由反大道的煽动者所为，企图以此抹黑大道方面。

医院

日军提出的第三点理由称，“工部局警务处（SMP）带走了轻伤人员，以免案件真相大白”，这一说法遭到驳斥，理由是任何需要医疗救助的人员总是由消防队的紧急救护车送往医院，而不会像其他地方可能有的做法那样，先让他们躺在街上接受盘问。

第四点理由引用了将死伤者移送至“杨树浦”警察医院一事。对此有人指出，自敌对行动开始以来，位于外虹桥（Wayside）的警察医院一直未投入使用；长期以来，它一直临时设在山海关路（卡特路旁）的埃利斯·卡杜里学校（Ellis Kadoorie School）。

尚未提出抗议

据悉，上海公共租界工部局并未召开特别会议讨论此事，预计工部局也不会就此发表任何声明。截至目前，尚未就针对金洛克巡佐（Sergeant Kinloch）的袭击事件提出任何抗议。

警方巡逻队继续在该地区的混乱地带道路进行严密巡逻，正如自三名华捕在阿美士德路（Amherst Avenue）巡逻遇袭、其中两人受伤以来所做的那样。然而，英军巡逻卡车现在除了步枪外，还配备了刘易斯机枪。

《上海晚邮报与信使报》

1939年8月21日

金洛克曾在苏格兰卫队
学习机枪使用

见习巡佐 W. L. 金洛克是工部局警务处的新近 recruits，几周前刚从训练所结业。虽然年轻，但他已在英国的苏格兰卫队服役数年，并曾在巴勒斯坦服役。他是机枪连的成员，该连由菲利普·H·卡特少校（Major Philip H Catt）指挥，卡特少校约五年前（当时为上尉）曾担任上海万国商团的副官。
